headline: Halcyon Textiles to present at regional manufacturing conference
body: Halcyon Textiles will present on supply chain practices at a regional conference in Leipzig. Executives are scheduled to take questions from attendees.

headline: Halcyon Textiles wins quality award from industry association
body: Halcyon Textiles received a supplier excellence award citing low defect rates and strong on-time delivery. The company plans to publish its audit results later this year.

headline: Halcyon Textiles publishes annual sustainability report
body: Halcyon Textiles released its annual sustainability report covering energy use and waste reduction targets. The report was prepared in line with standard reporting guidelines.

headline: Halcyon Textiles appoints new regional sales director
body: Halcyon Textiles announced a leadership appointment in its sales organization. The company said the change is part of a planned succession.

headline: Halcyon Textiles signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Halcyon Textiles announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.
